mission_09: Impressive! You have implemented three specialized time series anomaly detection methods that account for temporal structure. Rolling Z-score adapts to local changes in mean and variance, making it sensitive to sudden deviations from recent behavior. Seasonal decomposition isolates anomalies in the residual component after removing trend and seasonality, ideal for data with known periodic patterns. Exponential smoothing provides adaptive forecasts with exponentially weighted history, detecting anomalies through prediction errors. Each method has different strengths: rolling Z-score for abrupt changes, decomposition for pattern violations, and exponential smoothing for forecast deviations. In practice, combining multiple methods through ensemble approaches often yields the most robust time series anomaly detection.
